name: FreeToken
description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.
one_liner: Software that lets a large AI model, the kind normally run in a data center, run on a gaming PC or workstation at usable speed by cleverly splitting the work between the GPU and the CPU.
buyer: A technically sophisticated hobbyist or small startup that wants to run frontier-scale open AI models privately on owned hardware instead of paying ongoing cloud inference bills.
business_use_cases: A privacy-focused startup runs a large open-weight model entirely on-premises for sensitive client work, avoiding cloud API costs and data-exposure risk.
A systems integrator builds and sells pre-configured 'AI workstation' hardware bundles tuned for this engine as a one-time hardware sale.
An AI enthusiast community builds shared how-to content and configs for running specific popular models well on consumer GPUs.

money_ideas.idea: Selling pre-built, pre-tuned desktop hardware ('AI workstation in a box') bundled with this software configured out of the box.
Paid support/consulting for companies deploying it in production on owned hardware.

steal_this: Build and sell a single pre-configured hardware/software bundle for one popular model this quarter rather than trying to be a general platform — a narrow, concrete offer sells faster.
